feature_canonicalization_rules.string: exact frozen text; no normalization beyond the predeclared value itself
feature_canonicalization_rules.list: kept in frozen order unless the feature is defined as an unordered set (none in this schema); elementwise exact comparison
feature_canonicalization_rules.float: rounded to 4 decimals by the frozen extraction_rule before comparison
feature_canonicalization_rules.missing: NOT_AVAILABLE is never equal to any value, including another NOT_AVAILABLE, for pattern classification; a feature with any NOT_AVAILABLE case value is pattern NOT_AVAILABLE

similarity_rules.comparable_features: features where md-009 and md-015 are both not NOT_AVAILABLE
similarity_rules.interpretation_boundary: mechanical feature similarity only; does not imply same causal mechanism

responsive_difference_rules.shared_residual_features: features where md-009 and md-015 have equal available canonical values
responsive_difference_rules.denominator: shared residual features where md-004 value is available (not NOT_AVAILABLE)
responsive_difference_rules.differential_shared_features: denominator features where canonical(md004_value) != canonical(shared residual value)
responsive_difference_rules.interpretation_boundary: descriptive differential strength only; does not automatically support any mechanism

effective_analysis_design_semantic_paylo.shared_residual_rule: SHARED_RESIDUAL_HYPOTHESIS = YES only if a candidate supports both md-009 and md-015 and is based on NONRESPONDER_SHARED differential evidence; NO if md-009 and md-015 require materially different candidate evidence; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise
effective_analysis_design_semantic_paylo.candidate_generation_rule: a candidate hypothesis must originate from one or more mechanically observed differential features in the frozen feature inventory; intuition-only candidates are invalid

candidate_support_rules.STRONGLY_SUPPORTED: >= 2 independent differential domains; each domain contains at least one traceable mechanically reliable feature; features consistently differentiate md-004 from BOTH md-009 and md-015; candidate is compatible with prior A/B/G results; no direct frozen evidence contradiction
candidate_support_rules.SUPPORTED: one strong differential domain with multiple internally consistent mechanical features, OR >= 2 weaker independent differential domains; and no direct contradiction from prior intervention results
candidate_support_rules.PLAUSIBLE_ONLY: conceptually coherent but frozen evidence does not materially discriminate it
candidate_support_rules.NOT_SUPPORTED: frozen evidence directly contradicts candidate or prior intervention already provides relevant negative evidence
candidate_support_rules.forbidden: PLAUSIBLE_ONLY must not be promoted to NEXT_RESIDUAL_HYPOTHESIS

candidate_ranking_rules.eligible: only STRONGLY_SUPPORTED and SUPPORTED candidates enter the ranked shortlist
order: 2. case coverage: candidate supported by both residual cases > candidate supported by one residual case
5. if still tied: TOP_CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS = NOT_UNIQUELY_ESTABLISHED (no manual tie-breaking)
candidate_ranking_rules.tie_rule: ties must not be broken manually

effective_analysis_design_semantic_paylo.previously_tested_hypothesis_rule: these must be tagged PREVIOUSLY_TESTED_OR_CONSTRAINED; any overlapping candidate must state what new factor is actually different, otherwise the candidate is invalid
effective_analysis_design_semantic_paylo.next_hypothesis_rule: NEXT_RESIDUAL_HYPOTHESIS is emitted only when TOP_CANDIDATE_SUPPORT is SUPPORTED or STRONGLY_SUPPORTED AND TOP_CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS is uniquely established; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED with NEXT_DIAGNOSTIC_GOAL = DISCRIMINATE_TOP_CANDIDATES

effective_differential_pattern_rules.NONRESPONDER_SHARED: canonical(md009) == canonical(md015) AND canonical(md004) != canonical(md009) AND all three available
effective_differential_pattern_rules.ALL_SAME: canonical(md004) == canonical(md009) == canonical(md015) AND all three available
effective_differential_pattern_rules.MD009_ONLY: canonical(md009) != canonical(md004) AND canonical(md009) != canonical(md015) AND canonical(md004) == canonical(md015)
effective_differential_pattern_rules.MD015_ONLY: canonical(md015) != canonical(md004) AND canonical(md015) != canonical(md009) AND canonical(md004) == canonical(md009)
effective_differential_pattern_rules.NOT_AVAILABLE: at least one case value is NOT_AVAILABLE
